question: Do full probability vectors retain useful information lost by the current categorical-vote delivery, at the same legal feedback budget?
prior_evidence: Official field training is stronger in Macro-F1 but loses rare-class recall. The recommended categorical confusion combiner stays at 0.89417 in seed17. Adding a trained model as one more hard vote has already failed to beat the best training recipe. Do not repeat that selector.
mechanism: Use current observer posterior plus pooled-source and pooled-separate logistic probabilities. Compare equal arithmetic and geometric pools for each observer/field pair; compare a residual affine softmax on concatenated log probabilities with the same residual architecture receiving only softened argmax vectors. Residual is centred at equal geometric pooling, penalty 0.1 on all added coefficients/intercepts, maxiter 200. Fit class-balanced log loss solely to previous prequential feedback predictions. No current service labels and no resubstitution on base-model fit rows.
source: NeurIPS 2019 Dirichlet calibration Section3 supports log-probability affine softmax calibration. Multi-expert residual calibration, identity-centred penalty and online prequential arrangement are project adaptations, not an author implementation reproduction.
protocol: Keep original public ten-round model weights, service IDs, feedback pools and per-round32 cap. Use seeds17,47,89,101..110 already used for development. For each batch, predict service and feedback candidates, submit the actual service payload, then reveal only selected feedback labels and update the next batch. No feedback after the final batch. Shared field model bank gives all arms the same candidate set. Include current observer, all four fixed recipes and the known fixed midway recipe schedule as strong controls. Reproduce archived seed17 current and fixed outputs before accepting comparisons.
evaluation: Primary is final pooled service Macro-F1, reported separately by seed and mean over feedback draws. Report per-class recall, worst-class recall, paired rescues/harms, hindsight row upper bound as diagnosis only, actual CPU and output receipts. These draws repeat the same414 measurements and do not add independent data. Protect worst-class recall within0.02 of current, both default seed17 and draw-mean. A route that beats current and the strongest matched fixed control while protecting recall advances to real public-run all and frozen independent validation; otherwise stop this mechanism without tuning on these service labels.
budget: This phase allows at most6 recorded CPU jobs, each<=300sec, total1800sec additional, including small mathematical verification, shared-bank study, necessary repair, integration and validation. No external model service or platform submission. Failures count. If no full-probability route is competitive, reallocate to a different problem rather than grid-searching service answers.
